message: 知らない色
Now then, I wonder how Sally and Eauderourke are doing? Let's go check on them.
Thinking that, I started heading out toward the Shiokumi Shopping District, only to stop in my tracks halfway.
It hasn't even been half a day since those two started working at it. Clearly I'm worrying way too much--let's try again later. I need to have more faith in them.
Oh?
Just as I was about to head home, I ran into Azel walking at the same odd pace. I gave a light nod, but her gaze was off in the distance and she hadn't noticed me yet.
Azel would walk, stop, and after a short while, start walking again.
Or so it seemed--before she suddenly spun 180 degrees. Then she walked a few meters and came to a halt once more. For a casual stroll, she was acting pretty strange.

name: Synn
message: 「Hey there, Azel.」

name: Synn
message: 「What's the matter?」

name: Azel
message: 「W-What about you?」

name: Synn
message: 「I was just thinking of going to see Sally and Eauderourke. Though I've decided to hold off for today.」

name: Azel
message: 「What is that woman doing?」
Azel looks away from me toward a random direction... no, toward Kenseizaka Park right next to us, and tilts her head.
Misa is standing there alone with a serene expression, doing something.

name: Misa
message: 「Oh my? Azel-san and Sakura-kun, good day to you.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh. So by 'that woman,' you meant Misa?」

name: Misa
message: 「W-Wha--!? I can't let that slide. Just who are you calling 'that woman'?」

name: Misa
message: 「You're the Student Council President, aren't you? How dare you use such vulgar language! Hmph, if you can't even address someone by their name, you're unfit to be president!」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-You're completely right, except I wasn't the one who said it--Azel did!」

name: Misa
message: 「My, Azel-san did?」

name: Azel
message: 「...I know nothing of this.」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Whaaat!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Hold on just a moment, Sakura-kun!!」

name: Azel
message: 「A pointless argument.」

name: Synn
message: 「You think so?」

name: Azel
message: 「That's right.」

name: Azel
message: 「More importantly than such trivial matters... what are you doing?」

name: Misa
message: 「Me? I'm just picking up fallen leaves?」

name: Misa
message: 「Even though the autumn colors have only just begun, the impatient leaves are already blowing in the wind and scattering down.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, so you were cleaning up. I'll help out too.」

name: Misa
message: 「Excuse me?」

name: Azel
message: 「Cleaning, is it. Understood.」

name: Misa
message: 「Excuse meee!?」

name: Misa
message: 「How rude! I am trying to make pressed leaves!」

name: Azel
message: 「What is that?」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmm... it'll be faster if I just show you.」
Misa takes a paperback book out of her pocket and opens its pages. Pressed between them is a single ginkgo leaf, looking as though yellow is melting into green.

name: Azel
message: 「...May I touch it?」

name: Misa
message: 「Heehee, of course.」

name: Misa
message: 「You can have it if you'd like? I made that one last year. I've enjoyed it plenty already.」
Azel picks up the pressed leaf and flutters it between her fingertips.

name: Azel
message: 「It's stiff. Why is that?」

name: Synn
message: 「Because it's a pressed leaf. I make them sometimes too. Going out of your way to buy a bookmark is just a waste of money, after all.」

name: Misa
message: 「Wha--!? Please do not lump me in with you!」

name: Misa
message: 「Every year, I gather fallen autumn leaves and carefully select the very best ones!」

name: Azel
message: 「Why do it here? If you want plants that have changed color, there are plenty at the academy. The leaves in this park are halfway done.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, I was thinking the same thing.」

name: Misa
message: 「That's true... certainly, places at higher elevations like Ryuusei Academy and Asukai Shrine turn yellow much sooner. In the blink of an eye, really.」

name: Misa
message: 「It's surely thanks to how the wind hits them. Every leaf turns a gorgeous, solid red or solid yellow.」

name: Misa
message: 「In comparison, the leaves at Miseizaka Park turn yellow slowly...」

name: Misa
message: 「Still, I like this kind better.」

name: Azel
message: 「Why is that?」

name: Misa
message: 「Because the colors are so interesting.」
As she says this, Misa picks up fallen leaves from the ground and hands them to Azel and me.
Retaining late summer's deep green while shifting toward autumn yellow, the leaves hold an exquisite blend of hues--so many colors appearing on a single fallen leaf.

name: Synn
message: 「Wh-What color... should I even call this?」

name: Azel
message: 「Unidentifiable. A curious color.」
Just as Misa did, Azel picks up a fallen leaf herself to examine it.

name: Azel
message: 「No two leaves have the exact same hue. Why?」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry, I can't really answer that. That's just how it is.」

name: Azel
message: 「I have never experienced the four seasons. Is this what they are?」

name: Misa
message: 「Not just this, I'd say... though this is part of it, yes.」

name: Misa
message: 「Birds singing, plants budding, scents drifting through the air with each change. All of those things together are the four seasons.」

name: Azel
message: 「I see. Understoo--」

name: Misa
message: 「Azel-san?」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, right. Why don't you try pressing some of this year's autumn leaves too, Azel?」

name: Azel
message: 「...I do not know the method.」

name: Misa
message: 「All you have to do is slip them inside a thick book, you know?」

name: Misa
message: 「If you can, it's even better to stack several books on top and press them down nice and tight.」

name: Azel
message: 「Hold on. Does that mean the books cannot be read during the manufacturing process?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, that's right.」

name: Azel
message: 「...Hmph, how contradictory.」
Azel lets out a wry smile and gathers up several fallen leaves, and I follow her lead.
Misa doesn't seem interested in competing with Azel, instead sharing all sorts of tips on how to press leaves.
They'll probably be finished around the middle of this month.
